name: socialapp
description: PWA offline-first para apoyar el trabajo social en programas deportivos

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @socialapp/web" "npm run start:dev -w @socialapp/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @socialapp/shared && npm run build -w @socialapp/api && npm run build -w @socialapp/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @socialapp/shared && npm run test -w @socialapp/api && npm run test -w @socialapp/web
